name: npm-publish-security-scanner
description: Pre-publish security scanner for npm packages — detects sourcemap leaks, secrets, and unintended files

scripts.check:syntax: node --check scripts/run-all-scans.js && node --check scripts/scan-sourcemaps.js && node --check scripts/scan-secrets.js && node --check scripts/scan-unintended-files.js && node --check scripts/scan-dependencies.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:syntax && npm run scan
scripts.release: npm run check:syntax && npm run test && npm run scan && npm publish --provenance
